objective: Compute the real-time ampacity of an overhead line from weather data using a compact steady-state heat-balance model.

title.en: REL-TASK-014 — Dynamic thermal rating of an overhead line
title.ru: REL-TASK-014 — Динамический тепловой рейтинг воздушной линии

objective.en: Compute the limiting real-time ampacity over a short weather series.
objective.ru: Рассчитать предельный оперативный ток линии по короткому ряду погодных условий.

instructions.en: For each weather timestamp, solve the published steady-state heat balance: I^2 R(Tmax) + solar = convection + radiation. Report ampacity_by_timestamp_a, minimum_ampacity_a, limiting_timestamp, and overload_timestamps for the scheduled current.
instructions.ru: Для каждого момента времени решите опубликованный установившийся тепловой баланс: I^2 R(Tmax) + солнечный нагрев = конвекция + излучение. Укажите ampacity_by_timestamp_a, minimum_ampacity_a, limiting_timestamp и overload_timestamps для заданного планового тока.

submission_schema.ampacity_by_timestamp_a: object mapping timestamp to ampacity in amperes
submission_schema.minimum_ampacity_a: minimum ampacity over the weather series
submission_schema.overload_timestamps: timestamps where scheduled_current_a exceeds the dynamic rating

hard_constraints: All timestamp ampacities must match the independent heat-balance calculation within 0.5 A.
The limiting timestamp and overload timestamp list must be correct.
Unknown extra answer keys are infeasible.

metrics.name: feasible
metrics.description: Whether the submitted ratings satisfy all hard constraints.

source_provenance.notes: The public case uses a compact deterministic version of the standard heat-balance idea for executable evaluation.
